# Domestic Relations Division

The Domestic Relations Division maintains all records related to marital and non-criminal domestic disputes. All documents, including Certified Copies of Divorce Decrees and Dissolutions may be obtained at the following locations depending on the final disposition of the case.

Divorce decrees/Dissolutions from 1885-current year may be obtained in the Document Center located at the Hamilton County Courthouse, 1000 Main Street , Room 315. Phone: (513) 946-5693. Alternatively, Divorce decrees/Dissolutions from 1994-current year may be obtained from the Domestic Relations Copy Desk located at 800 Broadway, Room 347. Phone: (513) 946-9167.

All filings must be presented to the Docket office (800 Broadway, Room 346) for filing with the Clerk of Courts. The [Local Rules of the Court of Domestic Relations](http://www.hamiltoncountyohio.gov/government/courts/court_of_domestic_relations/local_rules/) provide additional information on court procedure. Also, see [Notice To All Domestic Relations Attorneys](https://www.courtclerk.org/forms/atty-notice-3105-88.pdf) for information about H.B. 535 pertaining to Property Division Orders. For more information or questions regarding the Domestic Relations Division, please contact any of the following offices for assistance or go to the [Court of Domestic Relations](http://www.hamilton-co.org/domestic/) website.

**Hours of Operation** Monday – Friday, 8:00AM – 4:00PM

**Location** 800 Broadway

Cincinnati, OH 45202

Phone: (513) 946-9150
